teaser: Three meetings before ten o'clock, and you have already set the order for each one. Life path 1 is called the leader; ESTJ carries the title of executive. Crossed, they do not soften each other — they confirm each other. The number asks for someone who trusts an instinct and acts on it without waiting for consensus; the type already runs a life by clear lines and plain answers. What is particular here is how little daylight sits between wanting to lead and knowing how to run the thing once it is yours. Few pairings move from idea to structure this fast.
